# Tests that fail under DEFRA_CLIENT=go-http. Enforced by .github/scripts/testo-report.py on every CI run:
# - each line is `<binary> <test> #<issue>`, and the issue must be open;
# - a listed test that passes fails the job ("fixed: remove from the list"), so the list only shrinks;
# - an entry a pull request adds is printed as a warning naming that pull request.
# go-http is the reference client: list a test here only when its issue explains why Go itself differs.
